Needs changes before merge.

The source review found no defect. One required test result remains incomplete.

What looks good:

- Both tools use the existing operation command. Validation and undo remain in that command.
- The tests cover explicit defaults, partial edits, undo, redo and refused inputs.
- The skill row and decision record describe the new tools. The body includes `Process change: yes`.

Local results:

The review used `.claude/worktrees/review-2792`. The trial merge with upstream/main `06d349391ca27e193a943fb37c51380e2c283f95` was clean. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: all 116 steps passed. The test logs report 994 passed, zero failed and 10 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run`: selected all app heavy targets, with 184 steps.
- The local heavy run had a 20-minute limit. The release build and the next 95 steps passed. No completed step failed.
- The limit interrupted step 97, `app heavy: pocket_recognition`. Steps 97 through 184 have no complete result. The heavy gate did not pass.

Extra suites run:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test turning_thread_infeed`: five passed, zero failed.
- No fixture or importer changed. The additional kernel suites were not required by the requested selection rules.

Safety checks:

These tools edit machining parameters. I repeated two reported mutations in the local review worktree:

1. Remove the unknown-field check: the refusal test failed with exit 101. Restore the check: all three MCP tests passed.
2. Decode the previous plan instead of the candidate: the refusal test failed with exit 101. Restore the decoder: all three MCP tests passed.

Both failures reached the expected refusal assertion. All temporary changes were restored. No golden file changed, so no moved golden required a line review. No UI file changed.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/app/src/mcp/mod.rs:77` and the PR body's Tests section: complete the reached heavy lanes and record their results in the body. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, under **Heavy lanes at review**, requires these results before readiness. The planner selects all app heavy targets for this diff. The body reports no heavy run, and this review's limited run did not finish. Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on the final head. Fix any failures and name the completed lanes in the body.

The head remains mergeable. The review label is `needs-rework` because the required heavy evidence is incomplete.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
